strategies.text: Casts Shadow Word: Pain and a fear (Psychic Scream); kill him quickly and keep the tank topped.
Fire Nova, Flame Shock and Shadow Bolt: spread to avoid Fire Nova and interrupt the casts.
Optional rare; avoid pulling it together with a graveyard pack.

notes: Level range is the client's Group Finder table (30-38); NeedRoll shows 26-36. The wing shares instance map 189 with Library, Armory and Cathedral. OpenMap has no pins for Scarlet Monastery. Vishas and Thalnos are placed by the room names on the map picture (Chamber of Atonement, Honor's Tomb); the three Graveyard rares have no position. No Method page was read for this wing: strategies are short summaries of the Classic fights, and Forever may have changed them. uiMapID 302 is from the retail table (unverified).
